text:
emma_sales: Hey team — rdv with Prospero on Thursday. They want a rip-and-replace path off CompetitorX APIs. Main asks: prompt parity, token billing delta, and KMS/SLA for enterprise. Can we sync POC checklist?

mike_solutions: quick list would help. do they want a full adapter or just a facade shim?

emma_sales: they said 'drop-in' ideally but opened to adapter if we need token mapping. primary blockers: session tokens + rate limit semantics. also pricing ask: how we bill truncated vs full tokens.

alex_engineer: technical note — CompetitorX does a handshake token with TTL=60s and session affinity by cookie. our runtime supports session-affinity but we need to map handshake->api-key exchange. simplest: an adapter that issues short-lived session tokens and persists mapping in Redis KV.

olivia_se: perf question: do we expect prefix caching to work the same? they rely on server-side prefix-cache for repeated prompts. we do prefix/KV caching but cache-key semantics differ (they key by prompt_id + model). need to document mismatch.

mike_solutions: can we provide a small smoke curl for them to run? if adapter is needed we should show minimal latency numbers.

alex_engineer: sure — example to hit our shim:

```
curl -X POST https://shim.redwood.company/v1/complete \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer ADAPTER_KEY' \ 
  -d '{"model":"open-instruct-v2","prompt":"translate: hello"}'
```

alex_engineer: note: if they replay full conversation we should enable KV cache bypass for initial rollout. that avoids stale prefix hits.

raj_security: security owners: they asked for KMS/HSM details in the vendor questionnaire. we support customer-managed keys (BYOK) with CloudKMS & HSM-backed envelopes. also need to confirm logs masking and retention. I'll draft the answers but need sample IP ranges for POC staging.

emma_sales: thanks raj — Prospero will insist on e2e encrypted at rest and in transit, plus SOC2 + custom DPA. add that to the doc.

sarah_pm: timeline check — sales wants a 2-week POC: week1 sandbox + quick smoke, week2 perf and parity checks. deliverables: 1) shim deployable in their VPC or our hosted staging, 2) parity checklist (prompt equivalence cases), 3) cost delta sheet.

mike_solutions: parity checklist: a) stopword/temperature edge cases, b) truncated token accounting, c) function-calls mapping, d) streaming chunk boundaries. we'll need 10 representative prompts from them.

olivia_se: also ask for their rate limit pattern: rps bursts vs steady. create a sample load profile so we can recommend batching/quantization.

emma_sales: I'll collect prompts and burst pattern. also need pricing answer: do we bill per token generated or per token processed? sales wants a clear comparison.

alex_engineer: we bill on generated+context tokens. for fairness, propose a migration credit that nets out their historic CompetitorX spend for month1. include an example calc in the sheet.

raj_security: sending vendor questionnaire notes now — get me the POC staging CIDRs and their data residency reqs. I will mark high-risk items (BYOK, audit logs retention >90d).

deploy_bot: deploy scheduled: shim-staging v0.1 -> us-central at 2026-03-19T14:20Z (link: https://deploys.redwood/company/deploys/5372) :rocket:

emma_sales: perfect. next steps: I'll email Prospero with the proposed 2-week plan and attach the parity template. can we meet tomorrow 10am for run-through?@mike_solutions @alex_engineer @raj_security

mike_solutions: 10am works. will bring sample latency numbers and cost calc template.

alex_engineer: 10am good. I'll prep adapter notes and the curl smoke test.

raj_security: I'll bring the redlines for the vendor questionnaire and draft BYOK steps.

olivia_se: I'll draft the prefix-caching mismatch doc and a recommended config for their traffic profile.

emma_sales: thanks all — I'll send calendar invite and the initial doc after this thread.
